title: How to Use the New "Record" Experience (Map + Stats on One Screen)
description:
Tap the Record option at the bottom of the Strava app and select a sport. Tap the record button to start the activity.

While recording, the map and real time stats appear on the same screen. Stats include pace, heart rate, distance, and other metrics depending on the device and connected sensors.

The map view updates continuously during the activity. After finishing, tap the pause button then the checkmark to save. The activity summary will include all recorded data. This feature works on both free and paid Strava accounts. Connect a heart rate monitor or other sensors for additional metrics.
